Metadata.description: Rent ready-made AI agents that get work done for you.

Home.title: AI agents that work for you
Home.subtitle: Choose an agent, describe the task, approve sensitive steps, and get the result.
Home.notConfiguredTitle: This installation is not configured yet
Home.notConfiguredBody: The administrator needs to complete the initial setup before the platform can be used.
Home.comingSoon: The agent catalog will be available soon.

Setup.title: Initial setup
Setup.intro: Configure the basic settings of this installation. You can change everything later in the admin panel.
Setup.tokenHint: Printed by the installer in the server terminal. Run "rentagent setup-token" to display it again.
Setup.siteNameHint: Shown to your users in the header, emails and browser tab.
Setup.timeZoneHint: IANA name, for example Asia/Jerusalem, Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
Setup.baseCurrencyHint: ISO 4217 code, for example USD, EUR or ILS. Prices in other currencies can be added later.
Setup.licenseKeyHint: Optional for now. It can be added later.
Setup.mailIntro: Used for email verification, password resets and notifications. Recommended.
Setup.smtpPasswordHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.smtpFailed: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the details, or uncheck SMTP to configure it later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Setup.ownerIntro: This account has full control of the installation. You will be asked to turn on two-factor authentication after signing in.
Setup.ownerPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. A long passphrase is best.

Validation.invalidOption: Choose one of the available options.
Validation.invalidCurrency: Enter a valid ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.
Validation.invalidTimeZone: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Europe/London.
Validation.invalidPort: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535.

Errors.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
Errors.errorBody: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

Legal.draftNotice: This page is a draft template. The operator of {siteName} must complete it and have it reviewed by a qualified professional before publication.
Legal.cookiesEssentialOnly: This site currently uses only essential cookies: session, security (CSRF), language preference and your cookie choices. They are required for the site to work and do not track you.
Legal.accessibilityCommitment: {siteName} aims to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA. If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please contact the site operator.

Consent.intro: Choose which optional cookies you allow. Essential cookies are always active because the site cannot work without them.
Consent.essentialBody: Session, security, language and consent preferences.
Consent.analyticsBody: Helps the operator understand how the site is used.
Consent.notInUse: Not currently in use on this site
Consent.bannerText: We use essential cookies to run this site and, with your permission, optional cookies for analytics and marketing.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device
signIn.verifiedNotice: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
signIn.resetNotice: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.setupNotice: Setup is complete. Sign in with the owner account you just created.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.name: Full name
signUp.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long passphrase is best.
signUp.success: Almost done! Check your inbox for a link to activate your account. If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder.
signUp.closed: Registration is currently closed. Contact the site operator for access.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.noEmail: Password reset by email is not available on this site. Contact the site administrator.
forgot.success: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Signing in with the new password will sign you out of all other devices.
reset.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long passphrase is best.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.codeHint: Open your authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password).
twoFactor.backupHint: Each backup code can be used only once.

AuthErrors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
AuthErrors.emailNotVerified: Please confirm your email address first. We've sent you a new confirmation link.
AuthErrors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
AuthErrors.invalidCode: The code is incorrect. Check your app and try again.
AuthErrors.locked: Too many incorrect codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
AuthErrors.signInUnavailable: This account cannot sign in. Contact the site administrator.
AuthErrors.sessionExpired: For your security, please sign in again.
AuthErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
AuthErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Full name
profile.emailHint: Contact the site administrator to change your email address.
profile.localeHint: Used for emails we send you.

security.title: Security
security.mfaRequired: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Turn it on below to access the admin area.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
twoFactor.scanStep: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
twoFactor.codeStep: Enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for setting up two-factor authentication in an authenticator app
twoFactor.backupIntro: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each can be used once if you lose access to your app.

password.title: Password
password.hint: At least {min} characters. Changing it signs you out of all other devices.
password.changed: Your password was changed and other devices were signed out.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices
sessions.revokedOthers: All other devices were signed out.

users.title: Users
users.count: {count, plural, =0 {No users found} one {# user} other {# users}}
users.name: Name
users.sessionsRevoked: All sessions of this user were signed out.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Security-relevant events. Entries cannot be edited or deleted from the interface.

settings.title: Settings
settings.smtpRequired: Open registration requires outgoing email (SMTP), because every new account must confirm its email address.
settings.openHint: Visitors can sign up and must confirm their email address.
settings.closedHint: Only existing accounts can sign in.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.lastOwner: The installation must keep at least one active owner.
errors.smtpRequired: Configure outgoing email before opening registration.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
